race.comment: Tricky little race with all having their first start as a 3yo. COMMIT (5) was a nice winner fresh at Sale and took another step forward second up at Sandown Hillside when finding the line strongly behind what looks a very nice horse in American Eagle. Third up, down in the weights and drawn well he can catch a few of these out. STAKES (7) got too far back at Caulfield second up but had won well fresh beating a subsequent impressive winner. Up to 1200m should suit nicely now. RICH ON BUBBLES (1) resumes. He won three in a row last time including a Listed race at Caulfield. He pays for that at the weights but has to be included. LEOPARD SHARK (2) outran her odds fresh at Flemington behind a talented debutant and is in the mix. TOUGH ROMANCE (8) was well spruiked in his maiden campaign and showed good ability, wary off a jumpout win here.
